newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WE COULD HAVE DONE MORE TO HELP MARADONA SAYS TEAM MATE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WE COULD HAVE DONE MORE TO HELP MARADONA SAYS TEAM MATE.

text.p: Juventus defender Ciro Ferrara, for seven seasons a team mate of Diego Maradona at Napoli, regrets that he and others did not do more to help Maradona kick his drug addiction.

Speaking to reporters from the Italian training camp in Florence this week, prior to Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Moldova, Ferrara said: "The problem is that Diego started on cocaine at Barcelona before he came to Napoli and we at Napoli only realised this too late in the day".
Maradona played for Barcelona in Spain from 1982-1984 before spending seven seasons at Napoli between 1984 and 1991.
"Sometimes, I would go round to Diego's house to persuade him to come to training and I would tell him that we had a big game coming up and that we all needed him.

"And he would respond, he'd react. He came to training and worked all the cocaine out of his system...and at the end of training we'd all go off, with him and Claudia (Maradona's wife) and eat a pizza together.
"Thinking back on it now, I imagine that every pizza he ate meant a sniff of cocaine less and that we ought to have invited him out every night"
